lines.text: In nineteen eighty-two, one man tied forty-five weather balloons to a lawnchair â€”
and accidentally soared three miles above Los Angeles.
See, truck driver Larry Walters always dreamed of flying planes,
so he strapped helium balloons onto a patio chair.
He packed sandwiches, soda, a radio, and a pellet gun for later.
Larry planned to float thirty feet up for lunch.
The chair blasted skyward like a rocket,
climbing to sixteen thousand feet right beside commercial jets.
Shocked pilots radioed the airport tower,
reporting a guy in a lawnchair holding a gun.
Shivering, Larry carefully popped a few balloons to drift down,
landing safely after snagging on Long Beach power lines.
Aviation officers slapped him with fines on the spot,
and Larry shrugged, saying a man can't just sit around.
